topic: 具身数据感知误差与认知误差区别

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (medium): 补足静态 taxonomy 中缺失的感知失败、误差归因和感知—认知解耦术语。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-robot-perception-failure
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:"perception failure" OR all:"perception error" OR all:"perceptual uncertainty")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 直接覆盖具身感知失败。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-sensor-drift-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:"sensor drift" OR all:miscalibration OR all:"temporal misalignment")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖漂移、标定与同步误差。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-multimodal-fusion-failure
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND all:"multimodal fusion" AND (all:failure OR all:robustness OR all:uncertainty)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖模态融合污染和缺失模态。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-failure-attribution
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"robot manipulation" AND (all:"failure attribution" OR all:"failure diagnosis" OR all:"failure detection")
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖失败定位和可观测诊断信号。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vla-uncertainty-recovery
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:VLA OR all:"vision-language-action") AND (all:uncertainty OR all:"failure recovery" OR all:intervention)
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖策略不确定性与恢复。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-perception-action-decoupling
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:robot AND (all:probing OR all:"action head") AND (all:perception OR all:representation) AND all:failure
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖表征正确但动作选择错误的解耦证据。

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-model-action-ranking
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world model" AND (all:"action ranking" OR all:admissibility OR all:"policy evaluation") AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: 覆盖预测保真与认知决策有效性的边界。
